correctness.rationale: In a real derivative-energy Hilbert quotient, squared difference-evaluation norms equal network resistances. Centering gives Q=F/T-J/(2T²). The edge Dirichlet-bridge covariance introduces the indispensable negative integrated same-edge term, establishing c_e=ell-r_ab-ell²/T and all graph formulas. Exact convex/concave/affine endpoint analysis is exhaustive, and Foster proves sum(c_e/ell_e)=beta1-1. A separately constructed grounded Kirchhoff Poisson solver verified 294 exact pointwise values and ten curvature identities. Finite checks corroborate only; analytic proof covers arbitrary real positive edge lengths.
